title: Yen repatriation monitor (Free edition)
standfirst: What Japan's investors bought and sold abroad, week by week and month by month, up to December 2025. This is the free edition, frozen at that date; the paid edition carries the 2026 turn and is refreshed as the data arrive.
index_desc: Japan's portfolio flows abroad to December 2025. Free edition of JMA's yen repatriation monitor.
